summary: Show contention for invented dock resources with inspectable event timing.
objective: Create a loading dock board with three bays, queued trucks and explicit service-start and finish events.
example_prompts: Create a loading dock board with three bays, queued trucks and explicit service-start and finish events.
Close one bay and show the effect on the pending assignment list.

entities.name: Dock facade
entities.guidance: Model three bay recesses, shutters, bumpers and bay signs.

entities.name: Trucks
entities.guidance: Distinct cab, chassis and box bodies with stable shipment labels.

entities.name: Queue lanes
entities.guidance: Mark waiting slots and dedicated dock approach paths.

object_craft.structure: Model three bay recesses, shutters, bumpers and bay signs.
object_craft.material: Matte industrial cladding and dark rubber-looking bumpers.

object_craft.structure: Distinct cab, chassis and box bodies with stable shipment labels.
object_craft.material: Painted body panels and muted glass.

object_craft.structure: Mark waiting slots and dedicated dock approach paths.
object_craft.material: Asphalt-looking ground with clear slot numbering.

state_contract.model: Authored first-eligible assignment policy; truck states waiting, approaching, servicing, leaving, done; dock capacity one; deterministic event queue.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Inspect waiting time from event timestamps.

invariants: A dock has one owner at most; approach reserves it before movement.
Closing a busy dock is rejected or deferred under an explicit visible policy.
Waiting and service durations use model time, not animation completion callbacks.
motion_guidance: Animate trucks only along assigned clearance paths; use turning envelopes and serialize conflicting approaches.
Do not imply docking precision from a smooth tween.
known_limits: Scheduling illustration with invented durations; not an optimization, safety or throughput study.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Bay recesses and lane markings make resource ownership spatially visible.

physical_contract.scope: Scripted docking motions attached to resource reservations.
colliders: Truck swept envelopes and dock facade bounds.
driving: Reserved path with speed and turn limits.
contact: Stop on conflicting reservation; no vehicle dynamics solver.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Simultaneous arrivals cannot reserve the same bay; reset clears ownership.
